description: Implement Shopify typed draft/order actions (Task 12) in packages/shopify-connector/. Implement Gate A-selected draft create/query/finalize/payment-record/query/cancel/full-refund action subset. Propagate Counter correlation metadata and prove safe query/idempotency behavior for each mutation. Normalize user errors, throttle, timeout-before-effect, timeout-after-effect, and unsupported state. Add development-store contract tests and process-kill recovery tests around each effect.
steps: Create packages/shopify-connector/src/order-types.ts: Define typed interfaces for Shopify draft order/order operations: DraftOrderCreateInput, DraftOrderResult, OrderFinalizeInput, OrderResult, PaymentRecordInput, PaymentRecordResult, OrderCancelInput, CancelResult, RefundInput, RefundResult. Include Counter correlation metadata (correlationId, idempotencyKey) in all inputs.

Create packages/shopify-connector/src/order-mutations.ts: Define GraphQL mutation strings for draftOrderCreate, draftOrderComplete (finalize), orderMarkAsPaid (payment record), orderCancel, refundCreate. Each mutation propagates Counter note attributes (correlation ID) as Shopify metafields/note_attributes.

Create packages/shopify-connector/src/order-actions.ts: Implement the ActionPort pattern (from @counter/connector-sdk action-ports.ts) for each operation: DraftOrderCreateAction, DraftOrderQueryAction, OrderFinalizeAction, PaymentRecordAction, OrderQueryAction, OrderCancelAction, OrderRefundAction. Each action handles: success mapping, user error normalization (ConnectorError), throttle detection (rate_limited), timeout-before-effect vs timeout-after-effect semantics, unsupported state transitions. Use the ShopifyGraphQLPort for execution.

Create packages/shopify-connector/src/order-error-normalizer.ts: Normalize Shopify userErrors and GraphQL errors to typed ConnectorError codes. Map throttle (THROTTLED) to rate_limited, validation errors to validation_error, not-found to not_found, permission to permission_denied. Handle timeout classification based on whether the mutation response was received.

Create packages/shopify-connector/src/order-idempotency.ts: Implement idempotency tracking for order mutations. Track correlationId -> outcome mappings. On duplicate request with same idempotencyKey, return cached outcome. Detect divergent duplicate (same key, different payload) and reject.

Create packages/shopify-connector/src/order-actions.test.ts: Contract tests using MockGraphQLClient. Test each action: success path, user error normalization, throttle handling, timeout-before-effect (no response = safe retry), timeout-after-effect (partial response = must query), unsupported state (cancel already-cancelled), idempotent replay. Include process-kill recovery scenarios (action started but not completed - query to recover).
Update packages/shopify-connector/src/index.ts to export all new order action modules.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build succeeds with no type errors in packages/shopify-connector
pnpm --filter @counter/shopify-connector test passes with all tests green
All 7 order actions implement the ActionPort interface correctly
Error normalization maps all Shopify error types to ConnectorError codes
Timeout semantics correctly distinguish before-effect from after-effect
Idempotency tracking returns cached outcomes for duplicate requests
Process-kill recovery tests demonstrate query-based recovery after interrupted mutations
Counter correlation metadata is propagated in all mutation inputs
findings: All 7 review issues addressed: tenant isolation, recursive payload hashing, manifest cross-check in health evaluator, engine-strict restored, idempotency store TTL/max-size, prefix-based simulation filter, and policy version-conflict detection via If-Match/ETag.
